description: This Java class, JwtUtil, provides utility functions for creating, parsing, and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWT) within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: JwtUtil
classes.description: Utility class for creating and validating JWT tokens.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for the given subject (typically the user email).

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Extracts the subject (email) from a JWT token.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the JWT token's signature and expiration time.
